items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: Dan was partial to this saxophone player, John Hardy, who played on a session.

ctx.x: It was a very earthy sound, and, uh, and, uh, extremely indigenous to the, at that time, to the Harlem scene. And, uh, of course, I was always overwhelmed by Pops Foster's bass playing. Yeah. Yeah. And, um, I thought that the rhythm was excellent. Of course, I would not make a record like that today, because I more or less, uh, let Dan have his head in that, and Dan was partial to this saxophone player, John Hardy, who played on a session. Well, played on a session. And I suppose that he was a very good saxophone…
I hate to follow along, uh, with the next recording sessions. All right.
